note: Both sets contain identical significant errors: they hallucinate a '3"' dimension in the bolt quote (the text reads '3/4" BOLT NUT WELDED TO WIDE FLANGE' without the 3" length) and misbind the 3/4" holes (which belong to the foundation/column base per the text grouping) to the deck opening plate. Set A uses slightly more descriptive entity names (e.g., 'PV attachment plate' vs 'plate'), but this minor improvement does not outweigh the shared factual inaccuracies and quote inventions.
